#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string s;
    cin >> s;

    int count = 0;
    int max_len = 0;
    int start = -1;
    bool inside = false;

    for (int i = 0; i < (int)s.length(); i++) {
        if (s[i] == '_') {
            if (start != i - 1) {
                if (inside)
                    count++;
                else
                    max_len = max(max_len, i - 1 - start);
            }
            start = i;
        }
        else if (s[i] == '(') {
            if (start != i - 1)
                max_len = max(max_len, i - 1 - start);
            inside = true;
            start = i;
        }
        else if (s[i] == ')') {
            if (start != i - 1)
                count++;
            inside = false;
            start = i;
        }
    }

    if (start != (int)s.length() - 1)
        max_len = max(max_len, (int)s.length() - 1 - start);

    cout << max_len << " " << count << endl;

    return 0;
}
